name: Mystic Disarmament, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level inquisitor 4, magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4
Area 20-foot radius burst

This spell functions as mystic disarmament except the greater burst radius and the target takes 1d4 nonlethal damage per 2 caster levels as the weapon is wrenched from them.
